items.title: File Baldwin County business personal property return
items.authority: Baldwin County property tax assessing official
items.description: Alabama business personal property returns are filed with the county assessing official; late returns carry a penalty. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.
